 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # Uniform separator rows and columns divide the canvas into panels.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    separator = None
    for color in set(v for row in grid for v in row):
        rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == color for v in grid[r])]
        cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == color for r in range(h))]
        if rows and cols:
            separator = (color, rows, cols)
            break
    sep, sr, sc = separator
    row_bounds = [-1] + sr + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sc + [w]
    regions = [[(row_bounds[i] + 1, row_bounds[i + 1], col_bounds[j] + 1, col_bounds[j + 1])
                for j in range(len(col_bounds) - 1)]
               for i in range(len(row_bounds) - 1)]
    colors = set(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = next(v for v in colors if v != sep and
                      sum(x == v for row in grid for x in row) > 1)
    mark = next(v for v in colors if v not in (sep, background))
    return [[1 if sum(grid[r][c] == mark for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)) == 2 else background
             for r0, r1, c0, c1 in row_regions]
            for row_regions in regions]
"
}

 "content": "from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Uniform full-width rows and full-height columns are panel separators.
    row_colors = [(r, grid[r][0]) for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    col_colors = [(c, grid[0][c]) for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))]
    sep = row_colors[0][1]
    row_seps = [r for r, color in row_colors if color == sep]
    col_seps = [c for c, color in col_colors if color == sep]
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != sep)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker = next(v for v in counts if v != background)
    r_bounds = [-1] + row_seps + [h]
    c_bounds = [-1] + col_seps + [w]
    out = []
    for i in range(len(r_bounds)-1):
        row = []
        for j in range(len(c_bounds)-1):
            n = sum(grid[r][c] == marker
                    for r in range(r_bounds[i]+1, r_bounds[i+1])
                    for c in range(c_bounds[j]+1, c_bounds[j+1]))
            row.append(1 if n == 2 else background)
        out.append(row)
    return out
"
}
